provider: Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO / Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ)

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only contract. The exact registration flow, endpoint/version contract and bounded station/data queries must be frozen in a later source-specific review. No automated data request is authorized here, and callers may not supply arbitrary hosts, paths or headers.

response_contract.format: Registered IOC/VLIZ Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility API/service documentation and, only after a later review, station/sensor-specific service responses.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The facility exposes heterogeneous raw real-time sea-level streams. Station operator, sensor, datum, sampling, gaps and feed lineage must be preserved; SLSMF feeds can overlap DART and must not automatically be counted as independent evidence.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No automated provider API probing is authorized by this documentation-only restricted contract. Exact provider limits must be reviewed before any future credentialed probe.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: The facility is operational and near-real-time; station availability, sensors, sampling and feeds can change. Any future accepted response requires retrieval time and source/feed lineage.

rights_and_policy.notes: The existing OpenCatastrophe source registry records that the facility Data Policy does not permit commercial use of data/products available through the website and directs commercial users to the relevant data originators. Registered API availability therefore does not clear commercial automation or downstream redistribution.

notes: This contract captures the important distinction between technical API availability and legal usability. It intentionally preserves the registered API as a documented route while blocking automated data use for OpenCatastrophe's potentially commercial insurance context until the relevant originator/API terms are explicitly cleared.
